description.en: Turns a short-drama episode into a shot-by-shot storyboard and a shootable screenplay. One representative frame per shot only ever gives composition, so camera moves and subject motion come from ffmpeg 4fps frame-diff contact sheets; luma jumps (signalstats YAVG) locate transitions and flashbacks where blackdetect misses the fade-in cut; hard subtitles are read from a cropped bottom-band sheet instead of a lossy strip OCR; fight and crowd scenes get their own sampling rates. Scripts follow Kenny SOP 1.7.2 strict mode and are machine-checked for length, scene count, consecutive shot lines, and OS/VO ratio. Requires ffmpeg; no network, no credentials.
description.zh: 把一个短剧/短视频扒成「运镜分镜表 + 可拍摄剧本」。每个镜头只取一帧只能读构图，运镜和主体运动必须靠 ffmpeg 4fps 连拍拼图做帧间差分；用 signalstats 的亮度跳变定位转场与闪回（blackdetect 会漏掉淡出型回忆切入）；硬字幕从底部条带裁切拼图读，比条带 OCR 准；打戏与群戏各有自己的采样率。剧本按 Kenny SOP 1.7.2 严格版产出，并机器自检字数、场次、连续画面行、OS/VO 占比。依赖 ffmpeg，不联网、不读凭据。
